name: BounceCards-TS-TW
title: BounceCards
blurb: Cards bounce into place with staggered elastic animation and hover effects.
description: Arranges images as cards that scale and rotate into place with elastic easing. Staggered animation on mount. Optional hover elevation. Uses GSAP for animation timing.
use_when: Image galleries, portfolio sections, or product showcases with visual interest.
avoid_when: Long lists of items; animation cost scales linearly with card count.
a11y: Images are displayed but have no alt text. Cards have no semantic meaning or keyboard interaction.
